scope: Independent methodology review before any proposed competence extension outcomes; no new model calls or instrument admission.
judgment: Defensible as a separately named one-shot prospective qualification of the fixed selected vector, not a revision of the original failed v2 gate.
recommended_conditions: Preserve v2 failed classification and all original 24 responses.
Freeze 192 new items from the same generator before collection; unchanged vector, prompts, arithmetic difficulty, action labels, selection and scorer.
Fresh 192 must independently meet original empirical absolute and relative competence thresholds; pooled 216 cannot rescue failed fresh data.
Pooled 216 may be an additional required gate or separately reported sensitivity.
A predeclared paired noninferiority interval on the fresh items can add evidence; specify the method and margin before outcomes.
Exactly one cohort and one look, no sample-size extensions or replacements after results.
Retain A/B/C task-specific readiness gates; arithmetic cannot establish general capability or advice competence.
